name: Helpless Vampirebat 96
author: AyuuLima
description: Blue checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ffffff to #000000, box-shadow becomes -10px -10px 50px 0px #1100f8,
    0 -10px 50px 0px #f30bf3,
    10px -10px 50px 0px #fde400,
    10px 0 50px 0px #6bff15,
    10px 10px 50px 0px #4c00ff,
    0 10px 50px 0px #ffc400,
    -10px 10px 50px 0px #5a69f0, left becomes 0.45em.
